input.description: Inspect working directory and git state

input.command: ls -la .claude plans 2>/dev/null; echo "---PLANS---"; ls plans; echo "---find instruction---"; find . -maxdepth 2 -iname "*instruction*" -o -maxdepth 2 -iname "*task*.md" 2>/dev/null | head
